resource.gene_subset: LINCS best-inferred (BING) genes only: 978 measured landmarks plus high-confidence inferred genes; 8,831 overlap the Bridge canonical universe
resource.interpretation: replicate-collapsed, plate-control-standardized moderated z-score signatures; each cell/dose/time signature remains separate

condition_signature.score_direction: signed Bridge attribution or matched moderated DE t statistic
condition_signature.rank_weight: linear from 1.0 at rank 1 to 0.002 at rank 500

primary_reversal_score: negative rank-weighted cosine between condition signs and LINCS Level-5 z scores on overlapping top-500 genes; positive means reversal
full_ranking_sensitivity: negative cosine between the LINCS z vector and signed condition ranks weighted by inverse square-root absolute rank

drug_consensus.context_unit: one LINCS Level-5 signature retaining cell line, dose, timepoint and replicate metadata
drug_consensus.sign_consistency: fraction of contexts with reversal score > 0

candidate_rule.competitive_random_drug_p: upper-tail rank of drug median against all eligible drug medians
candidate_rule.threshold: competitive p <= 0.01, median reversal > 0, sign consistency >= 0.60, >=3 contexts and >=2 cell lines
candidate_rule.fdr: BH reported but not required for descriptive candidate status

cross_study_rule: positive dataset-level median and competitive p <= 0.10 in every one of the three independent datasets, including OSDR

nulls.random_drugs: competitive empirical distribution across eligible compound consensuses
nulls.shuffled_signs: 2000 sign permutations for prioritized candidates; descriptive post-ranking validation
nulls.expression_matched_genes: 200 random modules matched by source-expression decile and L1000 measured/inferred status for prioritized candidates
nulls.cell_line: all results retain cell context; relevant-context subsets are reported separately
nulls.dose_time: individual contexts retained; sensitivity summarized by dose and time where at least three contexts exist

latent_reversal.reason: LINCS Level-5 z scores with inferred genes are not the validated 15,165-gene canonical log1p(TPM) Bridge input. Negative latent cosine would therefore be uninterpretable.

anti_tuning_statement: Resource, filters, scoring, candidate thresholds, context rules and nulls were fixed before loading the Level-5 expression matrix or examining reversal outcomes.
